tasks.label: Sumurai: compile
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'out' | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'out\images' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'assets\images\*' 'out\images'; $sources = Get-ChildItem -Path 'src\com\sumurai' -Recurse -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & javac -encoding UTF-8 -d 'out' $sources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Sumurai: test battle
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $testSources = Get-ChildItem -Path 'tests\com\sumurai' -Recurse -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & javac -encoding UTF-8 -cp 'out' -d 'out' $testSources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & java -cp 'out' com.sumurai.Test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
